description_en: Obtains the information of a file upload task
description_zh: 获取上传附件的任务信息
name: GetUserUploadFileJob

parameters.help_en: The key of the file upload task. The key is returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206059.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206060.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 上传附件任务JobKey，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206059.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206060.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: job_key

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

UploadFileJobDetail.description_en: The details of the file upload task

AttachmentKey.description_en: The key of the file that is returned after the file is uploaded. You can use this key when you upload the file as an attachment in a ticket
AttachmentKey.description_zh: 上传附件成功后返回的附件Key，可在创建工单时使用

FileSize.description_en: The size of the file. Unit: byte

FileSource.description_en:
The purpose of the uploaded file. Valid values:

datacorrect: The file is uploaded to change data.
order_info_attachment: The file is uploaded as an attachment in a ticket.
big-file: The file is uploaded to import multiple data records at a time.
sqlreview: The file is uploaded for SQL review
FileSource.description_zh:
文件上传的使用目的，取值与说明如下：
datacorrect：数据变更工单
order_info_attachment：工单附件
big-file：批量数据导入
sqlreview：SQL审核

JobKey.description_en: The key of the file upload task

JobStatus.description_en:
The status of the file upload task. Valid values:

INIT: The file upload task was initialized.
PENDING: The file upload task waited to be run.
BE_SCHEDULED: The file upload task waited to be scheduled.
FAIL: The file upload task failed.
SUCCESS: The file upload task was successful.
RUNNING: The file upload task was being run
JobStatus.description_zh:
上传附件任务状态，取值和说明如下：
INIT：初始化状态
PENDING：等待任务抓取
BE_SCHEDULED：待调度
FAIL：执行失败
SUCCESS：执行成功
RUNNING：正在执行

JobStatusDesc.description_en: The information about the status of the file upload task

UploadOSSParam.description_en:
The information about the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket from which the file is uploaded.

This parameter is returned if the value of UploadType is OSS
UploadOSSParam.description_zh:
上传附件OSS信息。
当UploadType参数为OSS时显示

BucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the OSS bucket

ObjectName.description_en: The name of the OSS object

UploadType.description_en:
The method used to upload the file. Valid values:

URL
OSS
UploadType.description_zh:
上传附件任务类型，取值：
URL
OSS

UploadURL.description_en:
The URL of the file.

This parameter is returned if the value of UploadType is URL
UploadURL.description_zh:
上传附件URL链接。
当UploadType参数为URL时显示

UploadedSize.description_en: The size of the uploaded file. Unit: byte
UploadedSize.description_zh: 已上传的大小，单位为字节
